data.name: MEKAKUSHI-SAN
data.detailed_description:
A game where you walk through an invisible residential neighborhood, revealing it with your gaze.

🎮 Game Overview


MEKAKUSHI-SAN is a first-person 3D horror adventure set in a Japanese residential neighborhood at night.


Direct your gaze to reveal terrain and paths hidden in the darkness. Use visual actions—looking, not looking, and closing your eyes—to make your way through the otherworldly town.

👁️ About MEKAKUSHI-SAN


MEKAKUSHI-SAN is a strange entity that appears in the town at night.


It emerges from the darkness with its eyes seemingly covered and pursues the player.


While looking can open the way, what you see can also bring you closer to danger.


MEKAKUSHI-SAN represents the fear of "looking" in this game.

📖 Story Introduction


You play as an elementary school girl exploring a residential neighborhood at night.


In a town wrapped in darkness, the paths you should be able to see disappear, and things you shouldn’t be able to see appear through your gaze.


Collect clues left behind in the town as you venture deeper into the otherworldly residential district where MEKAKUSHI-SAN appears.

🎮 Gameplay Features


A Japanese residential neighborhood explored in first person
As an elementary school girl, walk through a Japanese residential neighborhood at night and search for paths and clues hidden in the darkness.


An exploration system that reveals the town through your gaze
Terrain and paths appear wherever you direct your gaze. Areas you do not look at remain uncertain, making where you look the key to exploration.


Visual mechanics
Looking, not looking, and closing your eyes can make paths appear or obstacles disappear.


Escaping a supernatural entity
The entity MEKAKUSHI-SAN appears in the town. When it spots you, you must decide whether to run or hide.

🎨 Atmosphere and Visuals


The setting is a Japanese residential neighborhood at night.


Everyday places such as dimly lit alleys, parks, spaces in front of houses, and dark roads gradually transform into another world.


You rely on your gaze to move through the darkness, but looking doesn’t necessarily make you feel safe.


The game aims for an atmosphere where unease from what you can’t see overlaps with the fear of what you do see.

🎯 Target Players


Recommended for those who enjoy first-person horror, and for anyone who wants to explore a Japanese residential neighborhood at night.

🏁 Ending


The game has one ending.

⏱️ Estimated Play Time


1–2 hours

📺 Streaming Policy Summary


Streaming is permitted for both individuals and companies.


If possible, please include the game name and the store page URL in the description.


No prior authorization is required.
